tha-ap296:1.1: Saddasaññaka.] Anuggatamhi ādicce pasādo vipulo ahū / Buddhaseṭṭhassa lokamhi pātubhāvo mahesino. // //
tha-ap296:2.1: Saddam assos' ahaṃ tattha na ca passāmi taṃ jinaṃ / maraṇañ ca anuppatto Buddhasaññam anussariṃ. // //
tha-ap296:3.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap296:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Saddasaññako thero i. g. a-ti.
